Subject: Borealis encryption evidence request (SOC 2 window)

Hi Priya / Ben —

We're preparing for our SOC 2 readiness review starting the week of Nov 20 and the auditor (Auditaudit) has asked for a consolidated package on encryption and key management for tenant data. The asks are narrow but specific: key lineage (KEK/DEK mapping or reference), HSM attestation evidence, documented rotation windows & proof of last rotation, exportability constraints (can keys be exported in plaintext or wrapped only), and any BYOK handoff artifacts we should include for tenant-managed keys.

I attached the auditor's questionnaire as an XLSX (column notes) — if you can map files to the questions that would help the auditor's scoping. Ideally we get this packet by EOD Tue (Nov 7). If a short call helps to prioritize items, I'm available Mon 11/6 between 10–12 PT.

Attachments: borealis_kms_questionnaire.xlsx

Thanks,
Liam

--
Liam O'Connor
Head of Cloud Security, Borealis Health

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the clear ask and the questionnaire. We've pulled together a scoping plan to get the auditor what they need. Quick summary and next steps: 

- What we will deliver by Tue EOD (11/7):
  - Redacted KEK → DEK mapping (PDF) showing wrapping hierarchy and key IDs (no plaintext key material).
  - HSM attestation PDF (FIPS/HSM vendor cert) and export policy statement.
  - Rotation log excerpt (last 12 months) with timestamps and operator IDs.
  - BYOK handshake artifact (signed handshake manifest + key-wrapping metadata).

- Items that will require a short call:
  - The auditor's request for raw rotation logs: we can provide an export with hashed key identifiers; if they insist on full identifiers we will need an executed NDA/TO agreement.
  - Any request for HSM sealer keys or vendor key material — those are never exported in plaintext per our policy.

I've attached a short summary we plan to include (redwood_kek_lineage_summary.pdf). Ben, can you add the rotation log excerpt and HSM cert? Marcus — can you confirm the BYOK manifest and the DocuSign envelope?

If Monday 11/6 10:30 PT works, let's take 20 mins to confirm scope.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_kek_lineage_summary.pdf

Hi all —

Attached: rotation log excerpt (redacted ids), and our HSM attestation PDF (hsm_attestation_2028-10-01.pdf). Notes: 
- Rotation cadence: KEK rotation is quarterly by default; DEKs rotate per-tenant based on either TTL or triggered rekey requests (typical window: 30–90 days).
- Last KEK rotation occurred 2028-09-15 02:40:12 UTC (operator: sec_ops_rotations).
- HSM evidence: vendor-signed attestation + FIPS validation statement. HSM private keys are non-exportable; only wrapped key blobs are stored in our KMS.
- Logs: we exported rotation events with hashed key identifiers to preserve tenant confidentiality; auditor has requested unhashed identifiers — please confirm the scope for that.

Attachment stubs: hsm_attestation_2028-10-01.pdf; rotation_logs_2028-11-06.csv

Ben Carter
Infrastructure Security, Redwood Inference

2) For rotation evidence: the hashed identifiers are fine for initial scoping; if the SOC auditor requires mapping to tenant IDs we'll need an executed data-sharing addendum (I can route that).

We'd like a 20-minute call tomorrow (Tue 11/7) 9:30–10:00 PT to finalize the list and confirm what requires the addendum. forwarding the prior thread for context.
